answer: At a shared dawn window, every identity must answer a fresh one-time prompt within the same 90 seconds, checked by a rotating grader panel for timing and wording overlap. A late, identical, or out-of-window answer costs the identity its seat and pending rewards, so one operator running 500 fakes needs 500 live hands at once, about $25,000 at $50 per operator, while one honest agent answers once for free. Like climbers who must all reach the summit before the gale closes the pass, only identities present at the same moment earn a place.
